notes.title: Patch 0.312
notes.content:
Patch 0.312

Bugfixes:

 Water flow now also works in the self-generated maps.
 The fertility was not loaded correctly, this has been fixed.
 Due to a rounding error, the production displays of the individual buildings did not match the display for the general production, this has been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 0.311
notes.content:
Patch 0.311

Bugfixes:

 Water flow works again.
 Fixed crashes when loading game saves.

notes.title: Patch 0.310
notes.content:
Patch 0.310

Bugfixes:

 Buildings are now rotated correctly when loading savegames.

Changes:

 A map editor has been added that allows you to create and play maps yourself.

Patchnotes 0.301

the grass

the ground

notes.title: Patch 0.30
notes.content:
Patchnotes 0.30

Bugfixes:

    Siel and Low Lift Pump did work without street connection

Additional Features/Content:

a few seagulls and doves
trees and bushes
a tutorial within the first two maps
two additional maps
one additional dimension (now in 3D)

Changes:

Fertility:

the fertility can only be raised to maximum values by the farm or the forester
the farm produced from a certain fertility
residential houses have to be around 80% dry in order to produce

raised the start resources
changed a few texts
the save games names are limited now

notes.title: Patch 0.24
notes.content:
Patchnotes 0.24

Bugfixes:

    save and load menus sometimes crashed the game
    flickering issues with the "broke" menu (again)

Additional Features/Content:

a fertility map
while building buildings their borders are shown

Changes:

Streets:

removed the automatic street setting
the dike warden needs to set the streets manually
buildings have street connection points from which they need to be connected with the church in order to function
changed the start ressources
adjusted the visuals of the grass and the streets a little bit
revised game description

notes.title: Patch 0.23
notes.content:
Patchnotes 0.23

Bugfixes:

- main menu buttons clickable area was greater than the button in some resolutions
- flickering issues with the info panel

Additional Features/Content:

- added a grid overlay (only in low zoom levels)
- added a height view of the map
- added a height view with water 
- added a height view with water and water flow indications
- buildable objects are not deselected after building
- zoom while building
- game checks for compute shader support (there will be a warning if not)

Changes:

- small balancings of the water flow calculations
- grass and wheat grow slower
- game runs also in background now

notes.title: Hotfix V0.21
notes.content:
Hotfix to V0.21

- position of the back button in load menu
- sound control issues
